EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
Reference No. : 4/2/1/85. Land Ministry Ref. No.: 4-3/2/2016/CEB/21.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government has intend to acquire the under mentiance land/servitude for a public purpose.
Description of the land /servitude to be acquired :

Two allotments of lands as depicted in the names and extents in the Preliminary Plan No. ගȼ 4063 prepared by the Surveyor—General, and situated in the Village of Weralugampola in the Grama Niladhari Division No. 392/A, Weralugampala in the Division of the Divisional Secretary of Dompe in Gampaha District of the Western Province:
Preliminary Plan No. ගȼ 4063—Lot description

01. Lot No. 01 Name of the land: Punchi Nedungolla; Description: Garden, farmland with coconut and pineapple cultivation and well with cemented walls; Claimant by: Saman Weerakkodi, No. 154/A, Weliweriya Rd., Radawana; Extent 2.4454 Hectares.

02. Lot No. 02 Name of the land: Punchi Nedungolla; Description: Garden, farmland with coconut, rubber and pineapple ; Claimant by: Padmini Lokubalasooriya, No. 910/10J, Adhikaramwatta, Atulkotte; Extent 4.1225 Hectares.

All persons interested, possessed the right or with any other relation in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally or by agents duly authorized in writing before me at the Dompe Divisional Secretariat on 28th February 2018 at 02.30 p.m.

Further, they are hereby requested to notify to me in writing with two copies on or before 23rd February 2018 the nature of their interest in the land/servitude the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
H. G. J. P. WIJAYASIRIWARDHANE, Divisional Secretary, Divisional Secretariat Division of Dompe. At the Divisional Secretariat Dompe.

Description of the land /servitude to be acquired :
